title: Metrology Maven Result Package statement, format major version 1
description: statement.json of a Result Package (spec nodes TRUST.PKG.MANIFEST and TRUST.PKG.FIXTURE): an in-toto Statement v1 whose subjects are manifest.json followed by every manifest member in manifest order, and whose predicate is the package predicate. DSSE envelopes under signatures/ sign these exact bytes, or a signature statement whose single subject is their SHA-256. Rules JSON Schema cannot express, checked by readers: the first subject is manifest.json with the SHA-256 of the manifest bytes, which equals predicate.manifest_sha256; the other subjects equal the manifest members one for one; the bytes are RFC 8785 canonical with no trailing newline.

predicate.description: The package predicate. Minor versions of format 1 may add optional properties; 1.x readers ignore them.

result_count.$comment: Decimal string of a u64, no leading zeros (the full u64 range check is in manifest-1.json's member length).
